<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
COLS=(21,26,31,36,41)
def tstate(gg): return ''.join(gg[42][c] for c in COLS),''.join(gg[45][c] for c in COLS)
def bits(s): return int(''.join('1' if ch=='B' else '0' for ch in s),2)
def s2b(x): return ''.join('B' if (x>>i)&1 else 'w' for i in range(4,-1,-1))
tested={'BBBBB','BBBBw','BBBwB','BBBww','BBwBB','BBwww','BwBBw','BwBww','BwwBw','Bwwww','wBBBB','wBBww','wwBBB','wwBwB','wwBww','wwwBB','wwwwB','wwwww','BwBBw','wwwBw','wBwww','BwwwB'}
gray=[i^(i>>1) for i in range(32)]
g=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bar,stem=tstate(g); print('start:',bar,stem)
clicks=[]
# Phase A: wBBww(12) -> wwBBw(6): diff=10 -> bits 3,1 -> string idx 1,3
for si in (1,3):
    clicks.append((42,COLS[si])); clicks.append((45,COLS[si]))
# Phase B: gray walk from pos of 6, up to 9 untested
pos=gray.index(6); j=pos; prev=6; got=0
while got<9:
    j=(j+1)%32
    X=gray[j]; diff=prev^X; i=diff.bit_length()-1; si=4-i
    clicks.append((42,COLS[si])); clicks.append((45,COLS[si]))
    if s2b(X) not in tested: got+=1
    prev=X
    if j==pos: break
print('planned clicks:',len(clicks))
done=False
for k in range(0,len(clicks),2):
    chunk=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in clicks[k:k+2]]
    action(chunk)
    r2=last_action_result
    gg=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    b,s=tstate(gg)
    flag=r2.get('done') or r2.get('game_over') or r2.get('level_completed') or r2.get('run_complete')
    print(k,'bar/stem:',b,s,'flag:',flag,'timer:',gg[1].count('b'))
    if flag: done=True; break
result={'done':done}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

COLS=(21,26,31,36,41)
def tstate(gg): return ''.join(gg[42][c] for c in COLS),''.join(gg[45][c] for c in COLS)
def bits(s): return int(''.join('1' if ch=='B' else '0' for ch in s),2)
def s2b(x): return ''.join('B' if (x>>i)&1 else 'w' for i in range(4,-1,-1))
tested={'BBBBB','BBBBw','BBBwB','BBBww','BBwBB','BBwww','BwBBw','BwBww','BwwBw','Bwwww','wBBBB','wBBww','wwBBB','wwBwB','wwBww','wwwBB','wwwwB','wwwww','BwBBw','wwwBw','wBwww','BwwwB'}
gray=[i^(i>>1) for i in range(32)]
g=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bar,stem=tstate(g); print('start:',bar,stem)
clicks=[]
# Phase A: wBBww(12) -> wwBBw(6): diff=10 -> bits 3,1 -> string idx 1,3
for si in (1,3):
    clicks.append((42,COLS[si])); clicks.append((45,COLS[si]))
# Phase B: gray walk from pos of 6, up to 9 untested
pos=gray.index(6); j=pos; prev=6; got=0
while got<9:
    j=(j+1)%32
    X=gray[j]; diff=prev^X; i=diff.bit_length()-1; si=4-i
    clicks.append((42,COLS[si])); clicks.append((45,COLS[si]))
    if s2b(X) not in tested: got+=1
    prev=X
    if j==pos: break
print('planned clicks:',len(clicks))
done=False
for k in range(0,len(clicks),2):
    chunk=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in clicks[k:k+2]]

    r2=last_action_result

    print(k,'bar/stem:',b,s,'flag:',flag,'timer:',gg[1].count('b'))
    if flag: done=True; break
result={'done':done}
